Project_Gameservers_description: The Project GameServer Page table displays detailed information on all GameServers within a project, including server status, resource usage, and deployment details.
Project_Gameserversets_description: The Project GameServerSet Page table lists all GameServerSets within a project, providing insights into their deployment status, associated DeployUnits, and configuration details.
